newsitem.title: USA: American General to buy five lodgings.
newsitem.headline: American General to buy five lodgings.

text.p: American General Hospitality Corporation said on Monday it signed contracts and letters of intent to purchase five lodging properties.
Terms of the agreements were not disclosed. The company expects to complete the acquisitions during the first quarter of 1997.
American General Hospitality stated the acquisitions are contingent upon satisfactory results of its business and financial due diligence reviews.
American General Hospitality Corporation is a publicly traded real estate investment trust (REIT) and an active owner of hotel real estate.
